Name: C_SteeringWheel
Description: This will create a steering wheel controller

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: This will create a steering wheel controller. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). CtrlType: choose one option (for example: circleX, bounding_cube). CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: lightBlue, blue, white, purple). Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.
